summary: set ollama-16gib KV cache to q8_0
pull_request_body: The ollama-16gib tier sets OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE to q4_0 while the other eight tiers set q8_0. Ollama passes this value to llama-server for every model, including the embedding model. The 4-bit KV cache changes the vectors of qwen3-embedding:0.6b, so a vector from the 16gib tier has a cosine of 0.78 to 0.92 against a vector from a q8_0 tier. When the gateway routes a RAG embedding batch to the 16gib tier as an order-2 fallback, the drifted vectors enter the shared Qdrant collection and degrade retrieval. This change sets OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE to q8_0 on the 16gib tier, aligning it with all other tiers.
why: #2396 reports that the ollama-16gib tier uses a q4_0 KV cache while all other tiers use q8_0. Ollama passes the value to llama-server for every model, including the embedding model. The 4-bit cache changes the vectors of qwen3-embedding:0.6b, so a RAG batch routed to the 16gib tier as an order-2 fallback puts drifted vectors into the shared Qdrant collection and degrades retrieval.
what_changes: Change OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE from q4_0 to q8_0 in the ollama-16gib DaemonSet env block in k8s/llm/profiles/ollama-profiles.yaml.
Update the file header comment that references q4_0 KV cache to reference q8_0.
Add a spec requirement that all Ollama tiers in the embedding group use the same KV cache type.
feasibility: The premise is confirmed: line 126 of k8s/llm/profiles/ollama-profiles.yaml shows value: q4_0 for ollama-16gib, while lines 271, 411, 558, 707 and the remaining tiers show value: q8_0.
The gateway config at k8s/llm/gateway/config.yaml lists ollama-16gib-fast as an order-2 deployment of qwen3-embedding:0.6b, confirming the fallback path.
The archived change openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-28-2395-ollama-0-40-12/design.md explicitly defers this fix to #2396.
First check: grep for OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE in k8s/llm/profiles/ollama-profiles.yaml and confirm every occurrence has the value q8_0.
Second check: parse the YAML and assert that every DaemonSet container env block sets OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE to q8_0.
existing_tool: Not applicable. This is a one-line configuration change to an existing Kubernetes manifest. No external tool or library covers the need.

decisions.decision: Change OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE from q4_0 to q8_0 on the ollama-16gib tier.
decisions.reason: All eight other tiers use q8_0. The 4-bit KV cache changes embedding vectors, so a RAG batch routed to the 16gib tier as an order-2 fallback puts drifted vectors into the shared Qdrant collection. Aligning the value removes the drift.

decisions.decision: Do not add metadata to record which tier produced each vector.
decisions.reason: The proposed design in #2396 scopes this item to the one-line config fix. Recording the producing tier is a separate concern.

rejected.alternative: Remove the 16gib tier from the embedding group in the gateway config.
rejected.evidence: The issue scopes the fix to the one-line config change. The 16gib tier is a valid order-2 fallback for embedding, and removing it reduces capacity.

rejected.alternative: Add per-vector tier metadata in the Qdrant collection.
rejected.evidence: The proposed design in #2396 explicitly rejects this as a separate concern not part of this change.
